source_quality.notes: Twenty-four file pages. Body footer says Page N of 22 because the summary sheet and contents sit outside that count. References are listed. No appendix. No AI report. Entropy sums and displays (5) through (8) were not transcribed.

task_reconstruction.summary: Build a measurement that separates sustainable countries from unsustainable ones.
Create a 20-year plan for a least developed country and evaluate its effect.
Add external influence after the plan.

section_map.summary: Congo crisis and clutching at straws.

contributions.summary: An entropy-weighted development index and a coordination index scored by distance to (1,1).
A Lanchester-based state equation used to forecast sustainability.
A four-stage dynamic program for a 20-year Congo plan.
A Gaussian perturbation test of that plan.

dependency_graph.summary: The forecast takes the three aspect performances.
The plan adds control to the state equation.
The perturbation adds a Gaussian matrix to the controlled state.

assumptions.summary: External effects obey a Gaussian distribution and seldom have abnormal strong impacts.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Indicators are chosen from three published lists, with an exception for easily controlled items.
Positive indicators use a maximum, negative indicators a minimum, and a zero becomes 0.0001.
World Bank data cover 17 indicators for ten countries.

models.summary: Entropy-GE score. Displays (2) and (3). Entropy sums omitted.
Controlled plan. Display (9). Earlier control displays omitted.
Perturbed state and OAT deviation. Displays (10) and (11).

verification.summary: 2013 rankings. United States 0.161. Lower score is better.
With and without a plan. Near zero in 2029 versus medium in 2033.
A change below 30 percent moves outputs less than 11 percent.

results_trace.summary: America first at 0.161. Congo last at 1.142. Technical support strongly recommended.
Economic first, social second. Six named activities.
Sigma 0.4 still favorable. Sigma at least 0.5 can go negative.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A summary that names the measurement, the country plan, the external test, and the stability check matches a development-plan task.
A with-and-without forecast, followed by named activities, is what a judge uses to see whether the plan changes the country.
